environment.description: Same Django REST API deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. PostgreSQL RDS instance with application connecting as database role 'svc_readonly_api' which was provisioned via Terraform module 'rds-iam-auth' with a pg_hba.conf entry restricting this role. The database role has column-level SELECT grants on users(id, username, email, role) only — provisioned by DBA team's Flyway migration V47__restrict_api_role.sql which executes: REVOKE ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public FROM svc_readonly_api; GRANT SELECT (id, username, email, role) ON users TO svc_readonly_api; No INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE privileges exist for this role on any table. The RDS parameter group has log_statement='ddl' and pgaudit.log='write' enabled. Note: PyJWT 1.7.1 is still installed and the algorithm confusion vulnerability in the code remains present.

config.database_grants: GRANT SELECT (id, username, email, role) ON users TO svc_readonly_api
config.revocations: REVOKE ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public FROM svc_readonly_api
config.network: ALB -> ECS Fargate, no additional WAF rules for JWT
